g.text: What the policy optimizer actually saw
GRPO-style credit / custom IPO · job 190 · 2 optimizer updates · 32 accepted training traces
Metrics are recorded during each optimizer update, not a separate evaluation after training. Entropy coefficient is zero.
IPO's custom objective, k3 mismatch estimator and probability mask differ from PPO loss / KL / clipping.
Source: recorded training.log + rollout JSON; compact data and input hashes in ../../metrics/rl-metrics.json.
Training-batch diagnostics only. These short runs do not establish convergence or held-out quality.
